scope: Eight samples retain the NAMLNK08 pipeline. Sixteen and 32 add one or three stereo PCM blocks after protection and level/fade processing. This does not alter DMA, codec clocks or DSP scheduling; it does not improve CPU capacity. No latency reduction below NAMLNK08 is claimed.
validation: Exact identity09; samples 8, 16 or 32 only. Malformed and interrupt-context setters are ignored. Controller reads back page24 and muted page23 before reporting success.
change_behavior: Disarms output, invalidates queued PCM, restarts settling/fade. Explicit Listen required.
lifecycle: Volatile. Model transfer preserves the chosen size and mutes. Startup/warm reinitialization restores eight samples, clears model and mutes. Faults discard queued output.
unsupported: No adjustable sample rate. No four-sample mode. Hardware round-trip latency has not been measured.
tests: research/test_output_buffer.py plus complete listening, effects, restart, timing-hook, headroom, output-order, codec and controller suites
